Server-owned names are _ServerRef bindings, exactly as in\\npipeline.service, so tests patching pipeline.server still land.\\n\",\n \"import_before\": \"class PipelineService:\"\n}"

import ast
import json
import textwrap
from pathlib import Path

spec = json.loads(SPEC)
src = Path(spec["src"])
text = src.read_text()
lines = text.splitlines(keepends=True)
tree = ast.parse(text)
cls = next(n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.ClassDef) and n.name == spec["cls"])
methods = {m.name: m for m in cls.body if isinstance(m, ast.FunctionDef)}
impls, edits = [], []
for name in spec["methods"]:
    m = methods[name]
    first = m.body[0]
    has_doc = isinstance(first, ast.Expr) and isinstance(getattr(first, "value", None), ast.Constant) and isinstance(first.value.value, str)
    stmt = m.body[1] if has_doc else m.body[0]
    start = stmt.lineno - 1
    floor = first.end_lineno if has_doc else m.lineno
    while start > floor and lines[start - 1].strip().startswith("#"):
        start -= 1
    body = "".join(lines[start:m.end_lineno])
    args = [a.arg for a in m.args.args]
    impl = f"_{name}_impl"
    impls.append(f"def {impl}({ast.unparse(m.args)}):\n" + textwrap.indent(textwrap.dedent(body), "    ").rstrip() + "\n")
    call = ", ".join(["self"] + args[1:])
    edits.append((start, m.end_lineno, [f"        return {impl}({call})\n"]))
for s, e, rep in sorted(edits, reverse=True):
    lines[s:e] = rep
out = "".join(lines)
new_path = Path(spec["new"])
assert not new_path.exists(), f"{new_path} already exists - stop and report"
imp = "from ." + new_path.stem + " import " + ", ".join(f"_{n}_impl" for n in sorted(spec["methods"])) + "\n"
anchor = spec["import_before"] + "\n"
assert out.count(anchor) == 1, "import_before anchor not unique - stop and report"
out = out.replace(anchor, imp + "\n\n" + anchor)
src.write_text(out)
header = ['"""' + spec["doc"] + '"""\n', "\n"] + [ln + "\n" for ln in spec["direct"]]
header.append("\nfrom .service import _ServerRef\n\n")
header += [f'{n} = _ServerRef("{n}")\n' for n in spec["refs"]]
new_path.write_text("".join(header) + "\n\n" + "\n\n".join(impls))
print(f"{src} is now {len(out.splitlines())} lines; wrote {new_path}")
PYEOF

SPEC = "{\n \"src\": \"pipeline/server.py\",\n \"origin_module\": \"pipeline.server\",\n \"start\": \"def request_decision(\",\n \"start_offset\": -1,\n \"end\": \"def _ci_rework_feedback(gate_error: str, attempts: int) -> str:\",\n \"new\": \"pipeline/server_tools_lifecycle.py\",\n \"doc\": \"The decision, review, merge and plan-control MCP tools, moved verbatim\\nfrom pipeline/server.py (line-count target).\\n\\nThey register on pipeline.server's own FastMCP instance (mcp is a\\n_ModuleRef to it) when pipeline.server imports this module, and\\npipeline.server re-exports every tool name, so p.request_decision is still\\nthe registered object. _service resolves through pipeline.server at call\\ntime, so tests patching pipeline.server._service keep landing.\\n\",\n \"direct\": [\n  \"from typing import Any\"\n ],\n \"refs\": [\n  \"_service\",\n  \"mcp\"\n ],\n \"reexport\": [\n  \"advance_all_plans\",\n  \"advance_pipeline\",\n  \"approve_merge\",\n  \"list_decisions\",\n  \"pause_plan\",\n  \"request_decision\",\n  \"resume_plan\",\n  \"review_story\"\n ],\n \"import_after\": \"    return _impl(gate_error, attempts)\"\n}"

import json
from pathlib import Path

spec = json.loads(SPEC)
src = Path(spec["src"])
lines = src.read_text().splitlines(keepends=True)


def index_of(text):
    hits = [i for i, ln in enumerate(lines) if ln.rstrip("\n") == text]
    assert len(hits) == 1, f"anchor {text!r} occurs {len(hits)}x - stop and report"
    return hits[0]


s = index_of(spec["start"]) + spec.get("start_offset", 0)
e = index_of(spec["end"])
assert s < e
block = "".join(lines[s:e]).rstrip("\n") + "\n"
remaining = "".join(lines[:s] + lines[e:])
header = (["# ruff: noqa\n"] if spec.get("file_noqa") else []) + ['"""' + spec["doc"] + '"""\n', "\n"]
header += [ln + "\n" for ln in spec["direct"]]
if spec["refs"]:
    header.append("\nfrom .module_ref import _ModuleRef\n\n")
    header += [f'{n} = _ModuleRef("{spec["origin_module"]}", "{n}")\n' for n in spec["refs"]]
new_path = Path(spec["new"])
assert not new_path.exists(), f"{new_path} already exists - stop and report"
new_path.write_text("".join(header) + "\n\n" + block)
imp = "from ." + new_path.stem + " import " + ", ".join(spec["reexport"]) + "  # noqa: E402,F401\n"
anchor = spec["import_after"] + "\n"
assert remaining.count(anchor) == 1, "import_after anchor not unique - stop and report"
remaining = remaining.replace(anchor, anchor + imp)
src.write_text(remaining)
print(f"moved {e - s} lines to {new_path}; {src} is now {len(remaining.splitlines())} lines")

# Keep the two module-level re-export import blocks that sat between the
# moved tools in pipeline/server.py (tests import these names from it).
new = Path("pipeline/server_tools_lifecycle.py")
srv = Path("pipeline/server.py")
t = new.read_text()
b1 = """from pipeline.review_orchestrator import (  # verbatim move; re-export for monkeypatch compatibility
    _original_review_story,
    _verify_reviewer_auto_fix,
)


"""
b2 = """from pipeline.advance import _advance_pipeline_locked, _advance_pipeline_locked_impl


"""
assert t.count(b1) == 1 and t.count(b2) == 1, "re-export blocks not found - stop and report"
new.write_text(t.replace(b1, "").replace(b2, ""))
s = srv.read_text()
anchor = "from .server_tools_lifecycle import"
assert s.count(anchor) == 1
srv.write_text(s.replace(anchor, b1 + b2 + anchor))
print("kept the two re-export import blocks in pipeline/server.py")
PYEOF
